title: 极坐标旋涡 / Polar vortex
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Mirror your image before wrapping it into a traveling spiral tunnel, keeping its angular seam continuous. Bass moves the depth and highs countertwist it; depth power and source scale are editable.
descriptions.zh-CN: 先镜像折叠输入，再卷入前进的螺旋隧道，保持角度接缝连续。低频推动纵深，高频反向扭转；可编辑深度幂次、源缩放和柔光。
